events.text: Evernorth (XRP-treasury company) Class A shares begin Nasdaq trading under ticker XRPN.
events.detail: Evernorth said Oct. 9 it completed its business combination with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, holding about 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds; it expects to ring the Nasdaq closing bell Oct. 14.

events.text: Supreme Court hears Beaird v. United States.
events.detail: Whether courts must still defer to Sentencing Guidelines commentary under Stinson v. United States.

events.text: JPMorgan Chase reports third-quarter results, kicking off big-bank earnings.
events.detail: Results due about 7:00 a.m. ET with an 8:30 a.m. ET call, per the bank. Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo are also listed for Oct. 13 on public earnings calendars.

events.text: Johnson & Johnson reports third-quarter results; investor call 8:30 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Press release expected about 6:45 a.m. ET, per the company’s Aug. 31 notice.

events.text: UnitedHealth Group reports third-quarter results before the open; call 8:00 a.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and time per the company’s Sept. 15 release; webcast on unitedhealthgroup.com.

events.text: Supreme Court hears Salazar v. Paramount Global.
events.detail: How far the Video Privacy Protection Act reaches beyond traditional video providers.

events.text: September inflation (CPI) report, 8:30 a.m. ET.
Bank of America and Morgan Stanley report third-quarter results, the second day of big-bank earnings.
events.detail: Bank of America releases results about 6:45 a.m. ET with an 8:30 a.m. ET call, per the bank; Morgan Stanley reports before the open with a 9:30 a.m. ET call.

events.text: September Producer Price Index (PPI), 8:30 a.m. ET.
September retail sales (Census advance report), 8:30 a.m. ET.
events.detail: The government’s most timely read on consumer spending; lands the same morning as the September PPI.

events.text: Comment deadline on Treasury's proposed GENIUS Act stablecoin rules.
events.detail: Treasury's proposal sets how the GENIUS Act's limits on issuing, offering and selling payment stablecoins in the U.S. would work. Final rules come later.

events.text: Comment deadline on the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets.
events.detail: The proposal would add a safe harbor under which some crypto assets would not be treated as investment contracts under securities law. The SEC must still vote on a final rule.

events.text: Netflix reports third-quarter results after the close, about 4:01 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and time per Netflix investor relations; live management interview follows at 4:45 p.m. ET.

events.text: Tesla reports third-quarter results after the close; Q&A webcast 5:30 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Tesla already reported 486,532 Q3 deliveries on Oct. 2; profit and cash flow come with the earnings release.

events.text: Federal Reserve interest rate decision (meeting Oct. 27–28).
Alphabet reports third-quarter results; earnings call 4:30 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and call time per Alphabet’s Q3 2026 results conference-call notice.

events.text: Microsoft reports fiscal first-quarter results after the close; call 5:30 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Date and webcast time per Microsoft’s Oct. 7 announcement (2:30 p.m. Pacific).

events.text: Q3 GDP advance estimate and September personal income/outlays (PCE), 8:30 a.m. ET.
Midterm elections.
October Employment Situation (jobs report), 8:30 a.m. ET.
Supreme Court hears the challenge to third-country deportations (date to be set).
events.detail: Deportations can continue in the meantime; a decision is expected by summer 2027.

events.text: Government funding deadline.
events.detail: Congress must pass funding or another stopgap by then to avoid a partial government shutdown.
